metadata.title: Pakistan ThermoRail - Punjab Rail Corridor Historical Climate Trend Analysis
metadata.analysis_scope: 189 grid points within 35 km of rail lines (pk_rail_heat_v2.geojson)
metadata.finding_summary: Across all three views, pre-monsoon (May-June) 24-hour daily mean temperatures along Punjab rail corridors show no significant upward warming trend in this ERA5 reanalysis dataset. In View (a) (1961-1990 vs 1991-2020), mean P95 shift is -0.44 deg C (only 20.1% of points warmed). In View (b), mean daily mean shift is -0.06 deg C (34.4% warmed). In View (c), mean P95 shift is -1.77 deg C (3.2% warmed). These figures reflect reanalysis model outputs and known higher uncertainties in pre-satellite (pre-1979) atmospheric reconstructions.
metadata.caveat: Historical reanalysis (ERA5) pre-satellite assimilation (pre-1979) has higher uncertainty. These figures represent reanalysis model outputs, not direct station thermometry. The decadal trend analysis is kept as a reference artifact and is not displayed as an active forecast view.
